title: Libro Blanco del Desarrollo Español de Videojuegos 2023
methodology: DEV association report. The current estimate states 9,261 direct jobs in 2022; Figura 16 supplies the annual historical series. It separately totals direct, freelance and indirect jobs. PDF metadata: created 2024-06-11; 105 pages.
assessment: Primary decisive source for the two missing 2013-2014 direct-employment observations. Add only 2,630 and 3,376. The adjacent 2023-2026 values are forecasts and must not be added as actual observations.
access_status: full PDF downloaded and text inspected; retained as raw/DEV_Libro_Blanco_2023.pdf
next_step: Recover 2013/2014 original Libro Blanco editions or technical appendices if a fixed historical sampling-method audit is required. Do not infer that current sample design governed every historical year.

title: Libro Blanco del Desarrollo Español de Videojuegos 2024
methodology: DEV online CAWI survey at end-2024: universe estimated 495 active Spanish development studios/companies; N=292; DEV database and communication channels; stated finite-population error ±3.68% at 95%. PDF metadata: created 2025-05-23; 90 pages.
assessment: Independently confirms the accepted 2023 direct figure (10,259) on PDF p. 29 / printed p. 29, Figura 16. It yields no missing actual year because the 2024-2027 chart is explicitly forecast. Its 60% participation increase is a comparability caution, not a published series revision.
access_status: full PDF downloaded and text inspected; retained as raw/DEV_Libro_Blanco_2024.pdf
next_step: Keep the accepted 2023 observation; use the later 2025 edition for actual 2024. Do not turn 2024-2027 forecast values into observations.

title: Libro Blanco del Desarrollo Español de Videojuegos 2025
methodology: DEV online CAWI survey during 2025: universe estimated 500 active Spanish development studios/companies; N=283; DEV database and communication channels; stated finite-population error ±3.84% at 95%.
assessment: Latest recovered DEV edition as of this pass. It reports 10,508 direct jobs in 2024 and 2,330 external freelancers, then separately forecasts 2025-2028. No 2025 actual employment release was recovered. The actual 2020-2024 series agrees with the accepted 2020-2024 values.
access_status: existing authoritative raw PDF/text re-read; full source
next_step: Check DEV releases after the next fielded edition for a 2025 actual value; preserve direct jobs and external freelancers as distinct series.

title: La industria del videojuego en España: Anuario 2024
methodology: Association yearbook; inspected foreword says Spain's game industry employed 'more than 11,000' people directly, with thousands more indirectly. It does not give a recoverable exact workforce count or a compatible covered-population definition at the cited location.
assessment: Context only. Do not replace DEV's 10,508 development-sector direct estimate or use AEVI's rounded, broader industry claim as a series observation.
access_status: full PDF text inspected through public source
next_step: Use only if AEVI publishes a table defining exact direct employment, employer scope and treatment of development/publishing/distribution.

title: La IV Mesa de trabajo permanente del Videojuego presenta el Hub del Videojuego
methodology: Government news release attributes 7,320 direct professionals in 2019 to the Libro Blanco del Desarrollo Español de Videojuegos.
assessment: Government corroboration of an already accepted DEV 2019 figure, not an independent series or a missing observation.
next_step: No addition; retain DEV as the definition-bearing source.

title: El secretario de Estado de Cultura inaugura la presentación del Libro Blanco del Videojuego
methodology: Government release says the 2015 DEV book reported a 28% employment increase in 2014 but gives no absolute workforce number.
assessment: Corroborates direction only. It cannot replace the chart's 3,376 or create a separate observation.
next_step: Seek the original 2015 PDF if prior-year method or base is needed.
